page.overview:
Who is Cy Morgan?

Cy Morgan is a fictional character created by American comic book creator Michael Alan Nelson for his Boom! Studios Cthulhu Mythos series Fall of Cthulhu. He made his debut appearance in the first issue in 2007.

Cy is an average American man who as an adult studied at Arkham's Miskatonic University. He previously lived with and was engaged to a woman named Jordan, but their relationship ended with her supernaturally-motivated suicide.

Cy and his sister Sarah were raised by their uncle Walt after the death of their parents at a young age, and was fortunate enough to be accepted to study at Miskatonic University.

Later in life, Walt killed himself in front of Cy and his fiancé Jordan, leaving little but questions and a stack of occult artefacts in his wake. This prompted Cy to investigate what had happened to Walt, a journey which took him to the Dreamlands, led to a confrontation with the evil Mr. Arkham and, eventually, resulted in insanity and incarceration in a mental health facility. (: Fall of Cthulhu Volume 1: The Fugue)
